app_identity.name: FootPulse Analytics Pro
app_identity.tagline: Système de notation statistique avancée et analyse tactique des matchs de football européens

layout_and_spacing.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) + Mobile-First Stack
layout_and_spacing.grid_structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4 lg:gap-6

header_nav.description: Sticky navigation header with dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0E14]/90), search bar, quick league selector, date picker, and dark/light toggle.

match_card.description: Compact and detailed match card displaying Home vs Away, 0-100 Rating score, Attack/Defense/Form bars, signals badge, and quick access to match breakdown modal.

match_comparison_view.description: Full screen modal or sub-view for side-by-side comparison of 2 teams: Radar chart of stats (Tirs, xG, Possession, Discipline, Forme), Head-to-head history, Key players to watch, and transparency breakdown.

market_analysis_signals.description: Dedicated section showing statistical market signals (Over/Under 2.5, BTTS - Les deux équipes marquent, Clean Sheet, Avantage Domicile) with clear 'POURQUOI' explanations.

players_to_watch.description: Key player spotlights showing key metrics (Buts, Passes D., xG/90, Tirs cadrés/90, Rating /100). Includes 'Donnée indisponible' badge if stat is missing.

score_transparency_modal.description: On click of any score/100, displays transparent math breakdown showing exact weighted parameters (e.g. Score Offensif = xG (40%) + Tirs cadrés (30%) + Buts/match (30%)).

team_score_evolution.description: Sparkline and interactive line chart showing score progression over last 5 to 10 matches.

leaderboards.description: Tabs for Best Teams (Meilleures Équipes) and Top Players (Meilleurs Joueurs) sorted by Stat Rating /100.

unavailable_data_badge.label: Donnée indisponible
unavailable_data_badge.style: bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, match cards, filters, rating badges, search inputs, modal triggers, and buttons MUST contain unique descriptive data-testid attributes (kebab-case).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is strictly in French as requested ('Interface en français').
Never use generic purple (#7351B7 or any purple tint). Use tactical emerald (#10B981), cyan (#06B6D4), obsidian (#0B0E14), slate, and gold accents.
Ensure high contrast on all text and rating badges (APCA/WCAG compliant).
Mobile-first responsive design is mandatory. Test on mobile viewports with sticky category tabs.
Do NOT generate fictional fake data without label. If a statistic is unavailable or missing, show the badge 'Donnée indisponible'.
Implement clickable transparent score breakdowns so users can see how scores out of 100 are derived.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for modern, crisp technical icons.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational components.
